components.name: ControlPanel
components.summary: The shell for every experiment: a live preview area on the left and a 241px scrollable control panel on the right.

components.name: Field
components.summary: The wrapper for one labelled panel control: a .field-label above one or more .rows.

components.name: InputWrap
components.summary: The 24px grey input used everywhere: a text/number with an optional letter or icon prefix and optional suffix.

components.name: DimensionControl
components.summary: Figma-style width/height input that switches between a fixed pixel value and "Hug Content".

components.name: ColorInput
components.summary: Hex + opacity field with a live swatch and an optional full-width colour preview.

components.name: SnippetOutput
components.summary: A read-only code box showing the experiment's exported HTML, with a Download HTML button.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: A numeric value box beside a draggable 144px track.

components.name: SliderTick
components.summary: A slider whose track shows tick marks and snaps to them.

components.name: Divider
components.summary: A 1px hairline that separates sections of the control panel.

components.name: OptionSelector
components.summary: A searchable dropdown: type to filter, arrow keys to move, Enter or click to choose.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: An on/off switch row: a 24×16 track with a label, built on .

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A checkbox row with checked, unchecked and indeterminate states, built on .

components.name: CubicBezierInput
components.summary: A cubic-bézier easing editor: a 208×200 draggable curve above a text input, kept in sync.

components.name: FileUpload
components.summary: A single-file picker in the shape of a 24px panel input: a file icon, the file name and size, and a clear button.

components.name: ImageUpload
components.summary: A single-image drop zone: a 208×120 input-bg area that shows the image once chosen, with a file-name row and a clear button underneath.

components.name: MultiImageUpload
components.summary: A three-column grid of square thumbnails with an add tile.

components.name: ColorSelector
components.summary: A color field with a picker popover.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A small black tooltip with white text that labels controls on hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: SizeControl
components.summary: Width and height inputs side by side in one row, with a lock aspect ratio button.
